title: Candidate
description: An input the pipeline should look for anagrams of. One line of data/candidates.jsonl.

id.description: The input's folded letters, a colon, and the category. Stable under accents, spacing and punctuation, so 'Beyoncé' and 'beyonce' are one candidate.

input.description: The text as a person would write it.

status.description: new: not yet run. enumerated: has been through a queue. unclassified: the trending feed found it but no category could be assigned. rejected: not worth running (junk, or a person asked).
